flashcard_questions.q: A style of music that uses small musical ideas repeated for a long time, developing through gradual changes in texture, rhythm, dynamics or instrumentation.
A short musical pattern that repeats continuously throughout a piece or section.
A short repeating musical idea that comes and goes within a piece, rather than playing continuously.

flashcard_questions.a: The number of layers of sound in a piece and how they relate to each other.
A short, distinctive musical idea that can be developed and varied throughout a piece.
